facts.text: I attended a charity gala for children's education at the Marriott Hotel downtown last weekend.
I bid on a painting at a silent auction and won it for $500.
I met the founder of the organization, Dr. Patel.
Dr. Patel gave an inspiring speech about the impact of their work on underprivileged children.
I want to get involved with organizations that provide educational resources for underprivileged children.
I am thinking of organizing a charity event myself, possibly a charity run or walk.
I am thinking of reaching out to local businesses to sponsor my charity event or donate items for a silent auction.
I want to follow up on the sponsorship proposal package.
